summary: Frontend-only validation of the newly-built Simulation system (start → play → complete → session complete) for test user testagent2026@gmail.com. Logged in, discovered the enrolled session id 5e0c2a88-d864-4827-9a95-5aedd8d27ffd, and exercised every route in the Simulation flow plus the new SessionCompletePage. No blank pages, no console errors, no pageerrors. All declared data-testid selectors resolve. One data/config gap found: the master_simulations row for this session has sim_type='interactive' but its config is missing a recognised exercise_type (categorize/order/match/label), so InteractiveSim correctly falls through to its graceful 'interactive-unknown / Unsupported exercise type' empty state with a skip CTA. This is a SEED-DATA gap, not a frontend bug — the rest of the flow still navigates cleanly end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: master_simulations row for session 5e0c2a88-... has sim_type='interactive' but config.exercise_type is missing/unknown, so InteractiveSim renders the 'interactive-unknown' fallback. Frontend handles this gracefully with a skip button, but the drag/match/order/label paths could not be exercised against live data. Please seed config.exercise_type + items/categories/correct_matches/etc. for at least one interactive row OR confirm the expected JSON shape so a future test can cover the four sub-types.

action_items: Seed at least one master_simulations row per sim_type (excel / document / decision_making / interactive with each of the 4 exercise_types) so the drag-drop, spreadsheet, financial-document and narrative-decision paths can be regression-tested end-to-end. The InteractiveSim dispatcher reads config.exercise_type — the current row for session 5e0c2a88 doesn't have that key populated.

Confirm whether 'exercise_type' is the canonical key or whether the DB schema uses a different name (e.g. interactive_type / sub_type). If the latter, update InteractiveSim.jsx dispatcher to read the correct field.
critical_code_review_comments: SimulationPage.jsx handleComplete: if markPhaseComplete fails, console.error fires but the UI still navigates to /simulation/complete with an unsaved score. Consider a toast so the user knows the attempt wasn't persisted (currently silent).

SimulationCompletePage.jsx: reads location.state directly and defaults to {accuracy:0, tasks_total:0}. Direct-navigation or refresh will show a confusing '0% accuracy / Every rep compounds' screen. Consider redirecting to /session/:id/complete when location.state is absent, or re-fetching the last-saved simulation_score from user_sessions.

SessionCompletePage.jsx: treats phase_completed flags as the source of truth — notes_completed=true but quiz_completed / interview_completed / simulation_completed=false all show 'Skipped'. This is fine today but the 'You crushed all 4 phases' hero copy is always rendered even when phases are skipped. Consider making the hero copy conditional on all four being complete.

InteractiveSim fallback ('interactive-unknown'): good graceful degradation, but the copy says 'Unsupported exercise type' when the real cause is usually missing config. Consider distinguishing 'exercise_type missing in config' vs truly unsupported value — helps debugging seed data.

Confetti in SessionCompletePage mounts 60 absolutely-positioned spans with inline styles on every render pre-timeout. Minor perf nit: wrap the pieces array in useMemo so scrollbars / rerenders don't churn the DOM.

SimulationStartPage.jsx breadcrumb rendering for module title: `/^\s*module\b/i.test(module.title)` is a reasonable guard, but if module.order_index is null it would render 'Module null:'. Unlikely in practice but worth null-guarding.

rca of the issue: InteractiveSim dispatcher on line 845 reads `config?.exercise_type` and routes to one of four sub-components. The live master_simulations row for the test user's session has sim_type='interactive' and a populated config, but `config.exercise_type` is null/undefined, so the dispatcher returns the 'Unsupported exercise type' fallback. Reproduction: login as testagent2026 → Dashboard → enter any session → /simulation/start renders fine → click Start Simulation → /simulation renders the header but the body shows the 'interactive-unknown' card. Mitigation: populate config.exercise_type (one of categorize/order/match/label) in the master_simulations row, OR change the dispatcher to read from the DB's actual key (e.g. config.type).
